title: Potato Plant Disease Detection
description: AI-based system using deep learning and image analysis to detect diseases in potato plants early through leaf images. Helps farmers monitor crops, identify diseases sooner, and manage them more effectively.

title: EduBot — University AI Chatbot
description: Personalized AI chatbot that receives text messages about the University and responds accordingly. Demonstrates retrieval-based AI for institutional knowledge systems.

title: Student Performance Monitoring System
description: Full-stack web system to assess and track student performance, designed for students, faculty, and administrators with role-based dashboards.

title: IUB Alumni Bridge
description: Networking platform connecting IUB current students with alumni for mentorship, career guidance, and professional opportunities.

title: Air Quality Index Monitor
description: Web system for monitoring and visualizing pollution levels and air quality data across geographic areas with real-time data visualizations.

title: Product Recommendation System
description: Collaborative and content-based filtering recommendation engine that suggests products based on personal choices and aggregated user ratings.

title: Pirojpur Churashiyan — Event Platform
description: Dynamic event registration and notification platform showing participant lists, built for large-scale community events in Bangladesh.

title: Khaddya Bangla — Recipe Finder
description: Ingredient-based Bangladeshi recipe search app. Users search by ingredient and get matched recipes fetched from a structured JSON dataset.

title: E-School — Learning Platform
description: Frontend school management system enabling students to access classrooms, course materials, and resources online without hassle.

title: ML Algorithms Collection
description: Implementations of Root Finding, K-means Clustering, K-Nearest Neighbours, OLS Regression, Single Variable Regression, and Image Recognition models.
